films.title: Boys Don't Cry
films.overview: A young transgender man explores his gender identity and searches for love in rural Nebraska.

films.title: Stop-Loss
films.overview: A veteran soldier returns from his completed tour of duty in Iraq, only to find his life turned upside down when he is arbitrarily ordered to return to field duty by the Army.

films.title: Carrie
films.overview: An awkward, telekinetic teenage girl is the object of relentless bullying at school and an oppressively religious mother at home.
